conbody.p: To close the tailgate, lower and push the tailgate down firmly. Make sure that the tailgate is securely latched.

note.p: Make sure your hands, feet, and other parts of your body are safely out of the way before closing the tailgate.

You should always keep the tailgate lid completely closed while the vehicle is in motion. If you leave the tailgate open or ajar, poisonous exhaust gases may enter the car and serious illness or death may result.
To avoid damage to the tailgate’s latch, make sure nothing is near the latch and striker while closing the tailgate.
